A v0.4 coordinated cold backup made by the frozen v0.4 code (scripts/v04-instance.mjs: the v0.4 core writes app
versions and records, the v0.4 Host binds agent.sqlite, the v0.4 `agentos-admin backup` takes the backup). Synthetic
test data only: no provider secret, no personal data. Used by the m18-o09 VM check (V1-O09 drill, V1-M01 on a
machine). Never modified by the import; the manifest lists every file with its sha256.
